test_title: PYST 64: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 18 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

An __intense __wish to learn something keeps the nerves active.
solution:
The correct answer is 'powerful' i.e. **option 1****.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the word** "intense" **means having or showing strong feelings or opinions; extremely earnest or serious.
 
• Option 1: "powerful" - means having great power or strength, which is appropriate to substitute "intense".

Hence, the correct answer is** option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "fixed" - means securely placed or fastened or set, which is not suitable in this context.
 
• **Option 3: **"lazy" - means unwilling to work or use energy, which is the opposite of "intense".
 
• **Option 4:** "half-hearted" - means without enthusiasm or energy, which is not suitable in this context.
